en: Black‑and‑white street scene in a European town showing cobblestone roads, early 20th‑century brick and plaster buildings, and a large church with a tall spire and a square tower with a domed roof in the background. A bus or early motor coach with people standing around it is on the right, while pedestrians and children are seen on the left. The composition and wide white sky area resemble an old photographic postcard, but there is no visible caption or border text.
